news.title: England Women: Ella Toone and Chloe Kelly miss out as Sarina Wiegman names squad to face Greece in World Cup qualifiers
news.lede: England manager Sarina Wiegman has named a 23-player squad for next month’s World Cup qualifying play-off against Greece, with Ella Toone and Chloe Kelly both missing out. Kelly has yet to complete 90 minutes for Arsenal this season and has not started a game. The last time she was not called up by England was February 2025. news.title: FIFA accuses UEFA of 'misinformation campaign' over World Cup investment plan to derail Gianni Infantino's re-election campaign
news.lede: Legal battle erupts over World Cup investment planFIFA has fiercely responded to UEFA's legal manoeuvres in the United States, filing counter-documents in a Florida district court. Last month, UEFA requested the disclosure of evidence regarding the now-abandoned FIFA Forward Enterprise (FFE) scheme , threatening to lodge a criminal complaint in Switzerland against FIFA President Gianni Infantino. UEFA alleged Infantino engaged in "criminal mismanagement" by promoting a heavily undervalued proposition for personal gain.World football's governing body has rubbished those claims, accusing UEFA of waging a "misinformation campaign" as part of a targeted harassment strategy.

news.title: FIFA accuses UEFA of misinformation over Infantino’s World Cup plan
news.lede: FIFA has accused UEFA of using its legal effort to obtain documents about Gianni Infantino’s abandoned World Cup investment plan as part of an attempt to influence next year’s FIFA presidential election. In a filing to a court in Florida, FIFA rejected UEFA’s claims about the proposed FIFA Forward Enterprise (FFE), calling several of the European governing body’s statements about the plan and Infantino “false or misleading”. FIFA also described UEFA’s actions as a “misinformation” campaign. The dispute centres on Infantino’s proposal to create a commercial subsidiary that would manage major FIFA events, including the World Cup and Club World Cup.

news.title: A game for all: Taking football into diverse communities in Iceland, France and Ukraine
news.lede: Access to football should not be dependent on where someone lives or the barriers they face. Europe's national associations are committed to bringing the game to everybody, everywhere, who wants to play. Each year, UEFA Grassroots Week (23–30 September 2026) offers a chance to celebrate the organisations and clubs working to make football accessible and enjoyable for everyone across Europe – including people in isolated or underserved communities. Here, we highlight three national programmes taking the game to new places and more people.

news.title: Women's World Cup: Republic of Ireland call up Crystal Palace's Shanade Hopcroft for play-off
news.lede: Hopcroft returned to Crystal Palace earlier this month following a spell at Birmingham City. Republic of Ireland boss Carla Ward has called up Crystal Palace midfielder Shanade Hopcroft for next month's Women's World Cup play-off against Kazakhstan. England-born Hopcroft, 28, qualifies for the Republic of Ireland through her County Sligo-born grandmother. Formerly with the Chelsea academy, Hopcroft also previously played for Birmingham City and London City Lionesses.
